title: Lipschitz homotopy formula and homotopy mass bound from the characterization and the cylinder
statement: Notation: ℝ^m = Euclid m; 𝒟_k(ℝ^m) = GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid m)) k; 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) = TestFormOn univ k; |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α; M(T) = T.mass = T.massOn univ, M_W(T) = T.massOn W; spt = support; ∂ = boundary, ∂T(ω) = T(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply; dω = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k ω, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative ω); ι(t,x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; Jv = ι(0,v); S(X) = {ι(t,x) : t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X}; F^#ω(x) = (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x); X is NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for degree ≥ 1, = 0 in degree 0). Assume (VO) for all P, n, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0, (REP) for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n with μ(Uᶜ) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), and (if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U) μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0, (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for all N, N', k, A : ℝ^N →L ℝ^{N'} and k-covectors β on ℝ^{N'}, and (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for all N, k, v ∈ ℝ^N and (k+1)-covectors β on ℝ^N (exactly the type of the sibling dimred_mbl_dt_lp_covector_bounds), let lpush satisfy (CHAR) for all N, N', k, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, NC X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N), C^∞ maps Fs_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) with ‖DFs_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ' for x ∈ spt X and Fs_j → F uniformly on spt X, ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and ηs_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) each equal to Fs_j^#ω on some open set containing spt X, we have X(ηs_j) → lpush N N' k F X (ω), and let cyl be a map cyl : ∀ N k, 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with (C1) for NC X: spt cyl(X) is compact, M(cyl X) ≤ M(X), M(∂ cyl X) < ∞ and spt cyl(X) ⊆ S(X); (C3) for NC X and ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there is η : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η_t(x)(v) = ω(ι(t,x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J∘v)) for all t, x, v and cyl(X)(ω) = ∫_0^1 X(η_t) dt; (C4) for X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) with compact support and finite mass and ω ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}) there are η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with η_s(x)(v) = ω(ι(s,x))(J∘v) (s = 0, 1) and ∂cyl(X)(ω) = X(η₁) − X(η₀); (C5) for X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞ and ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) there are η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η_s(x)(v) = ω(ι(s,x))(J∘v) and ∂cyl(X)(ω) = X(η₁) − X(η₀) − cyl(∂X)(ω) (conjuncts 1, 3, 4, 5 of the sibling dimred_mbl_dt_lp_cylinder, verbatim). Then, for Λ-Lipschitz F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and L-Lipschitz H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} with H(ι(t,x)) = F(x) + t•(G(x) − F(x)) for x ∈ spt X and t ∈ [0,1]: (10) if X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) has compact support and finite mass, lpush G X − lpush F X = ∂ lpush (N+1) N' (0+1) H (cyl X); (11) if X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) has compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞, then lpush G X − lpush F X − lpush H (cyl(∂X)) = ∂ lpush H (cyl X); (12) if X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) is NC and dist(F(x), G(x)) ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X (δ ∈ ℝ), then M(lpush H (cyl X)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ·(2Λ)^k·M(X). (These are conjuncts (10)–(12) of the parent, verbatim.)
